name: menhir

attributes.attribute: a single large stone set upright in the ground
raised by the megalithic civilization some six thousand years ago
most were left whole, and the way of moving them is unknown

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: A menhir is a standing stone. It is a single large stone set upright in the ground. The people of the megalithic civilization raised it, about six thousand years ago. Some stones were cut or shaped into a set form. Most were set up as they came from the earth. No one knows how the stone was moved from the place where it was found, sometimes many miles away. The mystery of its raising is part of its wonder.

okr.objective: Document the menhir, the standing stone of a lost people.
key_results: the work of the megalithic civilization
the mystery of how it was moved and raised
